implementation.statement: Present verb ㄴ다느니/는다느니 normalize to 는다느니 with attached ㄴ, ㄹ deletion or non-ㄹ consonant spelling. Bare adjective statements use 다느니; listed prefinal statements preserve 시/었/겠. Article 40 aspirations preserve 타느니 recovery independently.
implementation.homonyms: Factual/copular 라느니 remains distinct from command 으라느니, despite shared short surface spelling and native 86079 identity. Commands have the (으) boundary; factual/copular recovery never inflects the nominal.
implementation.prefinals: Present verbs and commands permit existing honorific hypotheses, proposals and adjective questions stay bare, and 다느니/느냐느니/더라느니 do not repeat retrospective 더. Optional dictionary policy marks unlisted local markers unknown rather than certifying all polite combinations.
implementation.owners: Known immediate adjective/copula/verb owners obey the shared present/question/quoted-command checks, independently of earlier lexical or auxiliary components. Unclassified lexical heads remain raw hypotheses.
